title: Shio Ramen with Miso Soup
description: A Japanese-inspired bowl filled with flavorful ramen, topped with a vibrant green fenugreek and green onion garnish, served with a side of rich and savory miso soup.
instructions: Bring the shio broth to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and soy sauce.
Add the sesame oil to the miso paste mixture and whisk until combined.
Ladle the hot broth into bowls and top with cooked ramen noodles, chopped fenugreek leaves, and green onion.
Serve the miso paste mixture on the side for dipping.
